metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working with the Tabia platform — for Tabia teams, customers and partners.

plugins.name: tabia-cli
plugins.description: Reaching a deployed Tabia environment from the command line with the `tabia` CLI: profiles and personal access tokens, listing and reading through `tabia api`, and moving care pathways, flows and surveys between environments or organizations with export/plan/resolve/import. Treats personal data as the user's to read, never Claude's.
